title: DC All In Saga: Darkseid vs. the World #1
desc:
SCOTT SNYDER, JOSHUA WILLIAMSON, SANFORD GREENE AND YASMINE PUTRI TELL THE UNFORGETTABLE STORY OF DARKSEID'S PAST, PRESENT, AND FUTURE!

Darkseid is... only just beginning.

The ultimate anti-life in the universe has been at the heart of the DC All In Saga since its beginning...and while the King Omega battle has been won by the forces of good, the war against Darkseid has only just begun!

Comics superstars Scott Snyder and Sanford Greene present the hidden past of the being called Uxus, his descent into Darkseid, and his plans for the fate of all creation! It's DC's premier villain as you've never seen him before, by the biggest names in comics, in DC All In Saga: Darkseid vs. the World!
